items.title: Junior Mance Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 18, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Bob James is another one that used it, great on the electric piano.

ctx.x: Did you ever have an occasion to use the Rhodes?

Not on a gig. I’m not fond of electric pianos or electronic instruments. To listen to them yes. To play them no. Because the touch is too different. Same with the organ. The organ is entirely different touch than playing the piano. But I like to listen to a lot of things. You know there’s a lot of things Herbie Hancock has done a Fender Rhodes, or Bob James is another one that used it, great on the electric piano. But personally for myself — I had one once and the only reason I bought it was because I could put…
I thought I was hearing things.
